# Pi SDK

MIT, exact 0.80.3; reference commit a23abe4a695df8b69b613f73e9fdda2a8af894d4. See docs/48–51. SDK embedding uses custom education identity/tools, not the CLI entry.

`dependency-footprint.json` records the installed production dependency closure on Windows x64, including shared and nested packages. It is not an incremental installer size estimate. Native modules, WASM, offline installer layout and dependency audit remain release gates; see docs/51.
